data.long_meaning: The meaning of Jeronima is recorded in name-lists as “Liberator of the sacred yoke”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jeronima expresses “Liberator of the sacred yoke”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jeronima total 40, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
